Winter break · For coaches

Coaches Clinic 2026

Two days on the floor with Deng Awak and Jordan Naughton. Learn it in the morning. Coach a team of campers in the afternoon.
  • 2 days on court with Deng and Jordan
  • NBA and EuroLeague coaches on video in the coaches hour
  • Your own team in the camp games
  • Feedback after every game
  • A coaches-only hour each day
  • Session plans to take home
  • Lunch both days
  • Wednesday game day, free
Who
Coaches from any club, any level
Days
Monday 28 and Tuesday 29 December
Time
09:15 to 15:00
Where
Hafnia-Hallen, Julius Andersensvej 6, 2450 København SV
Places
30
Price
1.300 kr to Sunday 15 November, then 1.795 kr
Book a seat

Led by Deng Awak

Leads both days

Deng Awak

Talata Head Coach and founder

  • Pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark, including BK Amager in the Basketligaen
  • Worked with Kajus Mikalauskas and Danielius Lavrinovičius as young players in Lithuania. Both have since played EuroLeague for Žalgiris Kaunas
  • Player development at Žalgiris youth in Kaunas and Sostinės krepšinio mokykla in Vilnius
  • Has coached in four countries: Canada, Lithuania, Indonesia and Denmark
  • Captained Mount Royal University in Calgary, U SPORTS Canada West

Deng's full profile

Deng runs the clinic both days. He teaches you on the floor in the morning, watches your games and runs the coaches-only hour upstairs. Jordan Naughton runs the camp floor, so you see every drill run with real players before you take it.

Runs the camp floor both days

Jordan Naughton

Talata Head of Academy

  • NCAA Division 1 at the University of Wyoming, Mountain West Conference
  • Pro in Denmark with BK Amager in the Basketligaen
  • Head coach of Talata U17, U19 and the Stevnsgade girls team

Jordan's full profile

The day

09:15
Coffee and the day's session plan
09:30 to 11:30
On the floor with the camp. Jordan runs the first block with the players while Deng takes you through it. Then you run a station yourself
11:30 to 12:30
Lunch with the camp. Then your questions for Deng and Jordan while the players watch their film
12:30 to 14:00
The coaching. You take a team in the camp games, with feedback after every game
14:00 to 15:00
Upstairs, coaches only, with Deng. What worked, and the plan for your own practice

Monday is testing day, Tuesday is teaching. Wednesday 30 is game day, with games from 10:30. Come back free, watch or take your team again, then join the coaches-only debrief with Deng and Jordan after the last game. Fruit and snacks that day, no lunch.

On Monday or Tuesday, NBA and EuroLeague coaches join the coaches-only hour by live video call for a Q and A. We name each guest once they confirm.

Who you coach

Your team comes from our NBA and EuroLeague Pathway Camp, players aged 13 to 17 who already play in a club. What you see at 09:30, you run with them at 12:30.

We coach the constraints-led way: small-sided games, guided discovery, less talking. You see it run, then you run it.

Questions coaches ask

Can my club pay?

Yes. We send the invoice to the club.

Do I need a børneattest?

To run a team, yes. The campers are 13 to 17. We request it after you book. Coaching from abroad? You watch, run a station with our coaches and join the 14:00 hour.

What do I bring?

Indoor shoes, a notebook and your questions. Lunch, coffee and the camp t-shirt come from us.

What language?

English, both days.

Book a seat

30 places. Send this and your seat is held. Payment details come by email, and your club can pay by invoice.

Rather talk first? WhatsApp Deng.
